name: Shin-Nakano
tagline: Shinjuku in 7 minutes and Shibuya in 17 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Nakano City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 27 minutes to Otemachi, 7 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 38 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 37.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 37.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 33.8 m to 37.8 m, a difference of 4.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: コープ 中野中央店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 13 clinics and 21 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 新渡戸記念中野総合病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 圭友会小原病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Nakano-Shimbashi is ahead on quiet, but Shin-Nakano is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shin-Nakano. It takes 21 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shin-Nakano.

neighbours.lead: Nakano-Fujimicho is ahead on quiet, but Shin-Nakano is ahead on how close the centre is and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shin-Nakano. It takes 23 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shin-Nakano.

noiseSources: 青梅街道 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
中野通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
